Title: Vihaan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Vihaan - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Kavya - 9 years, daughter
Look: glasses, blue dress
3. Sonali - 37 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Vimla - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Ishaan - 10 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Vihaan stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Vimla stand near him.]

Vimla: "Vihaan, what's the plan today?"

[Vihaan dances to the music.]

Vimla: "Careful!"

[Vihaan hugs Mother tightly.]

Sonali: "Okay, Vihaan."

[Vihaan waves goodbye to Mother.]

Sonali: "One more time!"

[Vihaan shakes his head.]

Sonali: "That's great!"

[Vihaan shouts angrily.]

Vihaan (surprised): "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Vihaan stands in the living room. Kavya and Sonali stand near him.]

Kavya: "Let's begin."

[Vihaan combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Sonali: "One more time!"

[Vihaan puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Vihaan: "What happened?"

[Kavya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Vihaan: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
